product.olivetti-m380-xp9.summary: The high end of the 300 series in April 1989, announced at 33 MHz and listed as a server in the 1991 catalogue.
product.olivetti-m380-xp9.history: The documentation places M380/XP9 as the high end of the 300 series in April 1989, announced at 33 MHz and listed as a server in the 1991 catalogue.
product.olivetti-m380-xp9.architecture: Memory organisation determines expansion options. The guide identifies BA832 / BA833 / BA839. The board supports 4–8 MB and additional expansion uses memory boards. The guide lists ten slots and seven available, compared with eight in Computerwoche and the 1991 catalogue.
product.olivetti-m380-xp9.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.07 · PBZ1/PBZ0 (BA832/BA833) · PBZH1/PBZ0 (BA839) / 2.02 · PBZP/PBZQ.
product.olivetti-m380-xp9.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m380-xp9.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
